title: No easy instances
text:
Dungeon and raid monsters are much tougher, and bosses hit a lot harder.

• Every monster in the Sunken Vault, Hollowdeep Crypt and Cinderhold has 80% more health and hits 60% harder
• Dungeon bosses hit 60% harder and have 30% more health; Cinderhold's bosses hit 50% harder (on top of the raid tuning in v0.82)
⬆️ Monsters out in the open world are unchanged
